topics.title: What AI actually is
topics.summary: Most modern AI systems learn statistical patterns from data and use them to generate outputs. An articulate answer is not necessarily correct.

topics.title: Models, assistants and agents
topics.summary: A model is a technical component. An assistant adds a user interface; an agent may also call tools and take actions.

topics.title: AI for everyday life
topics.summary: Start with low-risk tasks such as outlining a letter, translating unfamiliar vocabulary, planning meals or learning a topic. Review anything important.

topics.title: Privacy and security
topics.summary: Inputs may be recorded or shared with services. Remove private data, limit connected apps, and verify policies before uploading documents.

topics.title: Creative AI and copyright
topics.summary: Music and visual-generation tools raise licensing, authorship, consent and platform-compliance questions.

topics.title: AI regulation
topics.summary: Rules vary by country. Distinguish proposed laws, passed laws and voluntary commitments.

topics.title: Local and open models
topics.summary: Some AI systems can run locally or publish weights; compare licenses, safety, hardware and privacy.

topics.title: AI company claims and metrics
topics.summary: A vendor benchmark, revenue estimate, funding event, valuation and monthly active users are not interchangeable measurements.
